name: testland/test-strategy-author
description: Build-an-X workflow producing a test strategy document for a project / release / feature - scope and in / out, test types per layer (unit / integration / contract / E2E / perf / security / a11y), risk-based prioritization (per risk-matrix), tooling stack, environments, exit criteria, and ownership. Use as the artifact stakeholders sign off on before significant test investment and return to for scope / quality questions. It is the umbrella document: for the per-release product risk table use risk-matrix, for the layer-ratio recommendation feeding its test-mix section use test-pyramid-balancer, and for the release done-criteria checklist use definition-of-done.
